newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Novanam places preference shares, plans listing.
newsitem.headline: Novanam places preference shares, plans listing.

text.p: Namibian fishing company NovaNam Ltd announced on Wednesday that 50 million convertible preference shares of N$1 each had been successfully placed with Namibian financial institutions and individuals.
The placement follows its acquisition of the Namibian fishing interests of Spanish company Pescanova S.A. with effect from December 31 1996.
Pescanova S.A. had guaranteed the performance of the NovaNam preference shares, the company said.
It was intended that the NovaNam preference shares be converted into ordinary shares which would be listed on the Namibian Stock Exchange in the near future, it added.
